scope: N6.3 native PS/2 pointer, local review candidate

diagnosis.scope: bounded root-cause diagnosis; not N6.3 acceptance
diagnosis.root_cause: Input generation/synchronization: oversized QMP vectors fill the PS/2 queue; reading drains generated bytes but does not trigger another mouse sync. The following opposite vector cancels un-emitted X displacement before it is packetized.
diagnosis.correction_required: Bounded zero-relative synchronization, only after all previously emitted packets are guest-read, until emitted axis sums equal the complete injected vector; keep exact corner/pixel assertions.

reused_host_assertions.counting: Final cumulative counters per executable, not sum of baseline and final lines

motion_transport_model.scope: host transport model, not native verification

bios_evidence_composition: Original BIOS native cases 0-15, 18 bootstrap failures, process exhaustion and checkerboard regression reused unchanged; remaining pointer/click/corners/held-exit and shell checks passed on normal BIOS with identical kernel/application identities.
image_recipe: Shared immutable GRUB private inputs via supported --xorriso hook; fresh UEFI ISO assembly, unchanged geometry and strict validators; no scratch deletion or shrink credit by adapter.
prior_N62_monitoring_disclosure: Preserved ~87-second unconfirmed query interval; no uninterrupted-isolation claim for that historical interval.
